title: From BIM to BM25: Visual Guide
outline: Title: From BIM to BM25: Visual Guide

1. From BIM To BM25 | the bridge: BIM's binary weight and the RSJ/idf weight on one side, BM25's new per-term multiplier on the other, with a term-frequency slider and a document-length toggle driving three score bars (BIM flat, linear tf runaway, BM25 saturating) | the additive skeleton and the idf weight are inherited unchanged; the only thing BM25 adds is a bounded multiplier in front of each weight, which repairs BIM's blindness to repetition and to length

2. The Saturation Curve | a live plot of tf/(k1+tf) with k1 draggable from 0 to 4, a crosshair at tf = k1 marking half the asymptote, a value table at tf = 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 and 100, and a toggle to the production numerator tf(k1+1)/(k1+tf) | evidence of aboutness is concave and bounded, k1 is the tf at half the asymptote, k1 = 0 recovers BIM exactly and large k1 approaches raw tf, and the (k1+1) factor rescales without reordering

3. The Length Dial | b and document length dragged against avgdl = 500, showing B, k1 times B, the effective tf and the resulting term score, plus a 300 / 500 / 1,500-word reference table marked inflated, neutral or deflated | B = (1-b) + b|d|/avgdl encodes your answer to whether long means verbose or means broader scope, and because it multiplies k1 inside the saturation function it acts as a per-document saturation rate rather than a linear penalty

4. Doc A Versus Doc B | the assembled formula with four tappable anatomy chips, and the worked head-to-head of a 300-word note against a 1,500-word page on the query vector index, recomputed live from k1 and b sliders with the crossover value of b reported | the short document wins 10.5 to 9.8 at the defaults despite 2.5 times fewer occurrences, and the verdict flips to 11.7 against 9.6 at b = 0, which proves b decides winners rather than trimming scores

5. Tuning By Symptom | five tappable result-list symptoms mapped to a prescription on k1, b or the idf variant, plus four collection types each yielding a starting pair | tune like a clinician by reading the symptom, remember that a two-term match scoring below a one-term match is negative RSJ idf and not a constant at all, and never compare BM25 scores across collections
